LESSON: HEALING BY THE END OF THE SUB

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The
Topic 3.4: Healing By the end of the sub

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Healing By the end of the sub. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Healing By the end of the sub
2. Practise Healing By the end of the sub at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Healing By the end of the sub

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Healing By the end of the sub
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Healing By the end of the sub. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Healing By the end of the sub at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Healing By the end of the sub at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Healing By the end of the sub
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Healing By the end of the sub. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Healing By the end of the sub using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Healing By the end of the sub in the examples.
2. Explain Healing By the end of the sub to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Healing By the end of the sub.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healing By the end of the sub using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Healing By the end of the sub important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Digital Literacy: the skill of connecting using technology is portrayed as learners watch a video clip on the birth of John the Baptist.
2. Creative Arts: creative skills are reinforced as learners sing and role play.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Healing By the end of the sub
2. Practise Healing By the end of the sub at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Healing By the end of the sub

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
